title: ErrorDocument
description: The document a failed invocation prints on stdout under `--format json`.

command.description: The command that failed, as its words (`"package sign"`); empty when the command line named none.

ErrorBody.description: The `error` object of an error document.

detail.description: The specific error within its category (e.g., `"oidc_token_rejected"`).

context.description: The packages the failure is about; always emitted, possibly empty.

ErrorContext.description: The packages an error is about.

identifier.description: The package a sign or verify failure is about.

source.description: The package a copy failure reads from.

target.description: The repository a copy failure writes to.
